nodes.description: Convert block tag (latest/earliest) or number to actual block reference

nodes.description: Extract stateRoot from the resolved block's header

nodes.description: Extract nonce, balance, codeHash, and storageHash from account

nodes.description: For each storage key, navigate from storageHash collecting proof nodes

nodes.description: accountProof and storageProof arrays have been constructed

nodes.description: Format proof data into JSON-RPC response structure

sub_graphs.title: EIP-1186: Proof Verification Logic
sub_graphs.description: Models how a verifier validates the returned Merkle proofs

nodes.label: Proof Data Received
nodes.description: Client has received eth_getProof response with account and storage proofs

nodes.label: Block Header Trusted
nodes.description: Verifier has a trusted block header with stateRoot

nodes.label: Verify Account Proof
nodes.description: Hash each node in accountProof and verify path from stateRoot to account

nodes.label: Verify Storage Proof
nodes.description: For each storage entry, verify path from storageHash to key-value pair

nodes.label: Verify Non-Existence
nodes.description: Follow path until divergence or empty branch proves value absence

nodes.label: Proof Valid
nodes.description: All proofs verified against trusted stateRoot

nodes.label: Proof Invalid
nodes.description: Proof verification failed, data cannot be trusted

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when the requested block has been pruned.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume RPC returns an error when historical state is unavailable due to pruning.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'enough data to verify this fact' for non-existent values is imprecise.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume proof includes all nodes down to the point where path diverges or branch is empty, following standard Merkle-Patricia trie proof semantics.

ambiguities.text: Maximum number of storage keys that can be requested is not specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementation-defined limits to prevent DoS, with error returned if exceeded.

implicit_assumptions.description: The verifier has access to a trusted block header from a reliable source.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Verification against a false stateRoot could accept fraudulent proofs, leading to incorrect state assumptions.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot forge Merkle proofs that validate against the correct stateRoot.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: State spoofing would be possible, breaking Layer 2 bridges and light client security.

implicit_assumptions.description: The RPC endpoint has access to the full state trie for the requested block.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incomplete proofs or errors returned, degrading service availability for historical queries.
